body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) has announced that ‘CES Unveiled in Amsterdam’ will return under a new name — ‘CES Unveiled Europe’. The rebranded event expands its focus to spotlight cutting-edge technologies and breakthrough ideas from across the continent, bringing together more than 70 influential brands and emerging startups alongside hundreds of industry leaders, government officials, media, and investors. Over 20 speakers will address the strength of Europe’s innovation ecosystem and the industry’s path forward.

“When the going gets tough, innovators show up,” said Gary Shapiro, CEO and Vice Chair of CTA. “In times of global uncertainty, it has never been more important to gather Europe’s brightest minds in technology. CES Unveiled Europe creates a community where innovation can thrive, and we can’t wait to see the best of Europe in Amsterdam this fall.”

Produced in partnership with the Netherlands Ministry of Economic Affairs and supported by the European Innovation Council (EIC), CES Unveiled Europe will serve as a regional preview of CES 2026. Since its debut in Amsterdam in 2017, the event has become a valued platform for showcasing the Netherlands’ vibrant tech sector. “We are proud to welcome once again CES Unveiled Europe to the Netherlands,” said Minister Dirk Beljaarts of Economic Affairs. “Our innovators, startups, and scale-ups have much to offer, and this event provides an important stage for them to shine.”

This year’s program includes an on-site pitch competition, with the winner earning a booth in Eureka Park, the startup hub of CES 2026 in Las Vegas. The event’s match program will also help connect participating startups with potential investors, offering opportunities to refine product presentations and business pitches ahead of the global stage.

“This exciting evolution to ‘CES Unveiled Europe’ expands beyond Amsterdam to highlight the remarkable innovation and dynamic companies from all across Europe,” said Kinsey Fabrizio, President of CTA. “It’s more than a name change — it’s a renewed commitment to elevating European innovation and offering one of the first glimpses of what’s to come at CES 2026.”

CES Unveiled Europe will take place at Beurs van Berlage in Amsterdam on October 28, 2025. Before that, the road to CES will stop in Paris for CES Tech Trends x FDDay on September 17, in partnership with France Digitale. CES 2026 will be held in Las Vegas from January 6 to 9.
